page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Main text in one column with diagrams interspersed. Left edge shows a fragment of the facing page's text in a narrow margin strip, which is partly cut off; those fragments are not transcribed as notes.

main_text.p: erunt 21, 14, 8, minimi datis continuè proportionales, ut hic uides:
Vt enim 3 ad 2, sic 21 ad 14: & ut 7 ad 4, sic 14 ad 8.

¶ Datæ sint hæ duæ similes rationes, siue proportio 3.2.6.4. Hic 2 & 6 compositi sunt adinuicè, quare eos ad primos siue minimos reduco, scilicet 1 & 3, eosdemq; inuersè colloco, ac 3 in 3 & 2 antecedentes, similiterq; 1 in 6 & 4 consequentes multiplico, facti erunt 9, 6, 4, datarum rationum continuè minimi, ut adscriptum cernis.
main_text.head: II.
main_text.p: Tribus quibuslibet rationibus datis, si termini duo adinuicem primi, quorum alter ex inuêtis antecedens

page.notes: The diagrams are rendered as approximate outlines; fractions and linking lines are described rather than exactly reproduced. The final line is a catchword-style continuation "L teceden-", where "teceden-" is a catchword split at the line end. Left-margin fragments of the facing page (e.g. "ins", "at,", "ce", "im") are partly cut off and were not transcribed. Marginal fragment words such as "se", "ntis", "ulti-" belong to the facing page and are not part of this page's text.
